name: High Forest
title: High Forest: The Wood of Mystery
description: The High Forest is the largest remnant of the ancient forest that once covered all of northern Faerûn. It is a place of deep magic and ancient secrets.
wiki: The High Forest is home to wood elves, treants, and varied magical creatures. It is mostly unexplored by humans, and those who enter often find themselves lost in its shifting paths. It guards the ruins of Hellgate Keep and the origins of several great rivers.

popup.title: Hellgate Keep
popup.description: The cursed ruins of a once-great elven city, now a place of dark power.

popup.title: Star Mountains
popup.description: Mysterious peaks that rise from the heart of the High Forest.
